name: Eternal Wish
source:
Because of her dislike of socialising, as well as the fact that she heavily immerses herself in alchemy, Iris is out of tune from others. Right before her, a messenger from the castle appears.

Receiving a request from her kingdom to complete creating the illusory gem, the "Ritos", which has the ability to lift any curse, Iris finds herself perplexed.

She eventually decides to take on the request in order to prove that she is a skilled alchemist.

By meeting wonderful people and receiving assistance from her tutors, her positive feelings eventually blossom into feelings of love...

--They even begin to profoundly change her destiny.

[Translated from [url=http://prcr.info/ew/story.html]The Official Website[/url]]
translation:
由于不喜欢社交，并且沉迷于炼金术，艾丽丝与其他人格格不入。就在她面前，一位来自城堡的使者出现了。

艾丽丝接到王国的委托，要求完成具有解除诅咒能力的虚幻宝石“Ritos”的制作，她感到很困惑。

她最终决定接受这个请求，以证明自己是一名熟练的炼金术士。

通过结识优秀的人并接受导师的帮助，她的积极情绪最终绽放成爱的感觉……

——他们甚至开始深刻地改变她的命运。

[译自[url=http://prcr.info/ew/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
